items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: With Buddy Rich, I did a T.V. show with him, and we did shows with ... Kate Smith. Yeah we did a show with her.

ctx.x: Is there something else? I mean you have a million stories, I can tell.

Oh, man, so many, I didn’t even put them down, but you know, all the different bands I worked with and how I got to work in bands including Cootie Williams, Duke Ellington, a lot of bands. With Buddy Rich, I did a T.V. show with him, and we did shows with — what’s the name, the lady that used to sing [sings] when the moon comes over the mountain? Kate Smith. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
